name: ButterflyMX
positioning: Video intercom and access control platform for multifamily, commercial and gated properties, hardware plus management software.
description: ButterflyMX sells building entry hardware — video intercom panels, keypads, smart locks, elevator and vehicle access controls, package rooms, security cameras — driven by one cloud platform that property staff and residents use from a phone. The software side covers resident directories, remote door release, visitor and delivery access, self-guided tour access and access logs. The vendor states the platform is used across more than 20,000 multifamily, commercial, student housing and gated communities.
real_estate_use: Whoever manages a multi-tenant building spends an unreasonable share of the week on entry: reissuing fobs, letting in a contractor, arguing about a delivery left outside, or driving over to open a door for a prospect. ButterflyMX replaces the physical key chain with credentials the manager grants and revokes remotely, and a resident answers the door from their phone whether they are home or not. For a leasing team, the same access grant is what makes an unaccompanied self-guided tour possible; for an owner, the access log is the record when something goes missing.
features: Video intercom answered from a smartphone
Cloud access control with remotely granted and revoked credentials
Delivery and visitor access, including package room control
Access logs and security camera integration

use_cases.job: Grant and revoke building access without reissuing physical keys or fobs
Let a prospect tour a vacant unit unaccompanied with a time-limited credential
